profile_text.body:
Cisco is a publicly traded worldwide technology company (NASDAQ: CSCO, CIK 0000858877) that describes itself as a leader in AI infrastructure, secure networking, and software solutions. Its site presents a broad portfolio spanning AI-optimized networking, purpose-built programmable silicon for AI workloads, data center modernization, and security embedded across network layers. The company describes its networking as designed to support hyperscalers, service providers, enterprises, and data centers, and notes that the McLaren Mastercard Formula 1 Team uses Cisco networking and security to process race data across 24 races worldwide.

On the AI side, Cisco positions itself around autonomous operations, describing policy-bound agents that execute complex workflows at machine speed while humans govern intent, policy, and risk. Cisco IQ is presented as a unified AI-powered experience delivering real-time insights, troubleshooting, automation, and agent-driven guidance for support and professional services. The site's tracked AI product is Cisco Webex AI, described as offering meeting intelligence, real-time translation, noise removal, and enterprise security.

The held facts record no litigation or MCP server presence for Cisco at this time.
